title: Plan Buffering with Priority Hedging and Invoice Muting (PRD)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD for a plan-level buffering feature that hedges priority groups against transient spikes, provides 'invoice muting' for small shortfalls, and creates explicit reconciliation flows for negative-balance scenarios.
background: Customers with multiple products and mixed traffic patterns requested a predictable billing experience when they exceed soft quotas by a small margin. Current overage behavior creates noise: immediate billing events for short spikes, losing credit allocations during rapid plan switches, and unclear invoices for negative-balance adjustments.
goals: 1) Reduce noisy invoices from transient soft-quota exceedances by introducing buffered allowances. 2) Ensure high-priority callers keep access during transient overloads via hedged priority pools. 3) Provide automatic invoice muting for shortfalls under a configured threshold and a reconciliation window.
non_goals: 1) Replace existing quota enforcement or hard-rate-limits. 2) Introduce cross-customer credit swaps. 3) Serve as primary fraud/abuse policy.
detailed_requirements: Entitlement buffer per plan: configurable amount (absolute tokens and % of monthly allotment).
Priority hedging: assign caller-level priorities (P0..P3) and map to allocation weights in buffer consumption order.
Invoice muting rule: if usage overage < X USD and reconciled within window W days, suppress immediate invoice and aggregate to next billing cycle.
Negative-balance reconciliation: create a ledger entry with reason codes and automated correction attempts before invoicing.
Per-route tagging: allow operators to mark routes as 'exempt-from-muting' (e.g., regulatory calls).
Telemetry: expose token-level and dollar impact of buffer consumption per plan and per-priority group in Console dashboards.
Admin UI: panel for configuring buffer size, muting threshold, reconciliation window, and emergency burst policy.
API: endpoints to query remaining buffer, request temporary buffer top-ups (manual), and retrieve pending-muted items.
Audit log: record every muting decision with rationale, user who enabled buffer, and automatic vs manual triggers.
Billing: suppressed invoices must still create draft ledger entries flagged 'muted' for later reconciliation.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal beta): enable for a small set of enterprise accounts with sandboxed billing; Phase 2 (opt-in): expose UI and API to select customers; Phase 3 (default opt-out): allow broad availability with conservative defaults.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Buffer configuration stored and applied: admins set a plan buffer (tokens and %) and it is applied to live requests within 5 minutes.
AC-2: Priority hedging enforcement: when plan buffer is consumed, higher-priority callers (P0,P1) continue to succeed at the configured weight while lower-priority callers are throttled or rerouted.
AC-3: Invoice muting: overage events below configured threshold are not emitted as customer-facing invoices during the muting window; draft ledger entries are created and flagged 'muted'.

AC-4: Reconciliation workflow: muted entries older than reconciliation window are either auto-invoiced or reconciled via credits depending on admin policy, and corresponding invoice lines appear in next billing run.

AC-5: Negative-balance handling: accounts with negative balances receive automated correction attempts and generate an incident only after 3 failed attempts; the ledger includes reason codes and TTL for corrections.
AC-6: Auditability: all buffer decisions appear in the audit log with user/timestamp/reason; Console shows token and USD impact within Cost Explorer.
AC-7: Metric coverage: dashboards populate buffer-consumption, muted-count, reconciled-count, and hedged-access-latency SLI within the Console for the pilot accounts.
AC-8: Security: configuration changes require admin role and are recorded; no PII stored in muting metadata.
AC-9: Performance: buffer decision path adds no more than 2ms median latency to request routing in production.
AC-10: API contract: endpoints to query buffer state return consistent data with Console within eventual consistency window of 30 seconds.
engineering_notes: Implement buffer as an overlay in rate-limiter service with token-first accounting. Use existing ledger namespace 'muted_overages' for draft entries. Need changes in billing run pipeline to handle 'muted' flags. Consider race conditions during plan changes; plan version must be attached to buffer snapshot.
qa_plan: 1) Unit tests for decision logic (buffer consume order, priority weighting). 2) Integration tests with billing-sandbox to validate draft ledger creation and reconciliation. 3) Load test to validate 2ms latency target. 4) E2E smoke scenario: simulate transient spike under muting threshold and ensure no invoice emitted for 30-day window.
